82046404-34bf-4ce9-9e12-beb5e4ebeda8.description: This professionally designed low-poly 3D character represents a classic medieval or fantasy merchant, perfect for indie game developers and animators. The model features a charming stylized aesthetic with clean, optimized geometry that ensures excellent performance in real-time engines like Unity or Unreal Engine. The merchant is depicted in traditional attire, including a layered tunic, a sturdy belt with utility pouches for coins, and simple traveler’s boots. The character design emphasizes a friendly yet hardworking personality, making it an ideal choice for a shopkeeper, a quest-giver, or a wandering NPC in a bustling town square. The textures use a vibrant, hand-painted style palette that complements the "toon" or "stylized" look, providing clear visibility and character even in top-down or mobile game perspectives. Whether he’s selling potions, spices, or antique primitives, this character adds life, narrative, and historical charm to any fantasy RPG or strategy project.
